program_name: iPhone 14 Plus Service Program for Rear Camera Issue
symptom: Rear camera may exhibit no preview
serial_check_note: Eligibility is confirmed only by Apple's serial number checker on the program page. RemedyAI cannot verify the serial number range.
remedy: Service free of charge by Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider
mandatory_conditions: Device must be an iPhone 14 Plus (no other iPhone models are part of this program)
Device serial number must be confirmed as eligible using Apple's serial number checker on the program page
Device will be examined prior to any service to verify that it is eligible for this program
Service must be obtained within three years after the first retail sale of the unit
exclusions_and_caveats: Any damage which impairs the ability to complete the repair, such as a cracked back glass, will need to be resolved prior to the service; in some cases there may be a cost associated with the additional repair
Apple may restrict or limit repair to the original country or region of purchase
This program does not extend the standard warranty coverage of the iPhone 14 Plus
The three-year window runs from the first retail sale of the unit, which may be earlier than your purchase date if the device was bought used or refurbished
If you believe your iPhone 14 Plus was affected and you already paid to have the rear camera repaired, Apple says you can contact Apple about a refund
